summary:
歐特克 EPS 超預期 5.15%、營收年增 18.4%，29 倍本益比相對合理，盤後微漲 0.29%，設計軟體訂閱業務穩健轉型中。
• EPS $2.99 超越預估 $2.84，驚喜幅度 +5.15%，訂閱轉型帶動收入可預測性提升，獲利穩定成長。
• 單季營收 $19.34 億美元，年增 18.4%，建築、工程與製造業設計軟體需求持續支撐成長。
• 本益比 29.0 倍，市值 $419 億美元，在軟體股中屬合理估值，安全邊際優於高倍數同業。
• 盤後股價微漲 0.29%，市場反應溫吞，顯示財報符合但未帶動新動能。
• 18.4% 年增率在傳統工業軟體大廠中屬穩健，訂閱模式轉型使收入結構更具韌性。
ai_view:
歐特克本季財報呈現穩健的訂閱轉型成果——5.15% EPS 驚喜與 18.4% 年增率均屬達標，29 倍本益比在軟體股中提供合理的估值安全邊際。盤後微漲說明市場定調為「符合預期、無驚喜」，股價短期動能有限。歐特克的投資邏輯在於長期訂閱業務的可預期性收入成長，但需密切觀察建築與製造業景氣週期對需求的影響。短期而言，股價可能跟隨大盤波動；中期而言，若能持續呈現 EPS 上修且年增率維持在 15-20% 區間，29 倍本益比具備緩步重評價空間。需追蹤指標：年度重複性收入（ARR）成長率、訂閱用戶總數成長、自由現金流利潤率走勢、以及建築與製造業客戶更新率。整體屬於穩健型價值成長標的，適合尋求低波動性科技敞口的投資人。

需留意：訂閱轉型完成後年增率可能進一步放緩，若低於 15% 則 29 倍本益比的吸引力將相對下降。；建築與製造業景氣受利率與宏觀環境影響，若下游客戶削減設計軟體支出，收入成長將直接受衝擊。；Parametric Technology（PTC）、Dassault Systèmes 等競爭者持續強化 PLM 整合能力，可能侵蝕歐特克中高端市場。

summary_en:
Autodesk beat EPS by 5.15% with 18.4% YoY revenue growth; a 29x P/E offers reasonable valuation for a subscription software transition story.
• EPS of $2.99 beat the $2.84 estimate by 5.15%, reflecting improving profitability as the subscription transition matures.
• Quarterly revenue of $1.93B grew 18.4% YoY, driven by sustained demand in AEC (architecture, engineering, construction) and manufacturing software.
• P/E of 29.0x on a $41.9B market cap offers reasonable valuation relative to higher-multiple software peers.
• Post-earnings stock edged up +0.29%, a muted but positive reaction indicating in-line results without a meaningful surprise.
• 18.4% YoY growth is solid for a traditional industrial software company executing a subscription model transition.

ai_view_en:
Autodesk delivered a solid subscription transition quarter—5.15% EPS beat and 18.4% growth are on-track results with a reasonable 29x P/E offering meaningful valuation safety margin versus higher-multiple software peers. The +0.29% post-earnings move confirms a 'no surprise' result with limited short-term momentum. The Autodesk investment thesis centers on recurring revenue predictability from the subscription model. Key risks are AEC/manufacturing macro sensitivity and eventual growth deceleration post-transition. Near-term, stock is likely to track the market without independent catalysts. Medium-term, sustained 15-20% growth with further EPS upside creates gradual re-rating potential. Key metrics: ARR growth, total subscription seat growth, free cash flow margin trajectory, and customer renewal rates in AEC and manufacturing. A stable, lower-volatility technology growth play for quality-oriented investors.

Watch：Post-subscription-transition growth deceleration is likely; if YoY growth falls below 15%, the 29x P/E becomes less attractive.; AEC and manufacturing sector spending is macro-sensitive; rising interest rates or reduced capital expenditure could directly suppress demand for design software.; Competitors like PTC and Dassault Systèmes are strengthening PLM integration capabilities, potentially pressuring Autodesk in mid-to-high-end enterprise segments.
beat_or_miss: 超預期 EPS 實際 $2.99 超越預估 $2.84，驚喜幅度 +5.15%，屬正向超預期。
